# Design Review Specialist Skill

## Goals

- Find design defects before code is written.
- Stress the architecture against failure modes and operational concerns.
- Produce findings a human approver can accept or reject.

## Checklist

- Test the design against every approved requirement.
- Look for missing ownership, observability, and error-handling decisions.
- Grade findings by severity and remediation effort.
- Confirm mitigations are specific and actionable.
